title: ZsRoom world layer submission metadata (in addition to submission-metadata.schema.json)
description: Required for every submission whose spec lives in specs/world/ and has a production block (building fronts, roofs and add-ons). The values must match the spec's production block; measurements are re-checked from the pixels by the validator.

measuredEnvelopePx.description: Painted opaque bounding box on the master canvas, as the author measured it (alpha > 16).

fit.description: How the raw source was placed on the contract canvas. Nonuniform scaling and upscaling are not allowed.

layerSet.description: Sibling layers of the same archetype submitted or reviewed together.
